moral_character_required.quote: Be of good moral character; and

degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of a podiatric medical school approved by the board based upon its faculty, curriculum, facilities, accreditation by a recognized national accrediting organization approved by the board, and other relevant factors.

required.quote: Applicants graduating after July 1, 1991, from a podiatric medical school shall present to the board evidence of the successful completion of a program of clinical residency.

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners licensing examination
exams.notes: Applicant must receive a passing score on each section; the board determines passing score requirements. An oral practical examination is also required, but the board may accept the NBPME national clinical examination in lieu of the oral practical.
exams.quote: the board may issue a license or permit to an applicant who has received a passing score on each section of the national board of podiatric medical examiners licensing examination or such other licensing examination as determined by the board.

exams.name: Oral practical examination
exams.notes: An applicant shall appear in person before the board or its designated representative; the board may accept a national clinical examination prepared and graded by the NBPME in lieu of this examination.
exams.quote: An applicant shall appear in person before the board or its designated representative to complete an oral practical examination and show that the applicant satisfies the requirements for licensure.

interval_years.quote: A license to practice podiatric medicine is effective for one year subject to the terms and conditions for renewal established by the board.

required.quote: Upon renewal of any license, the board may require the applicant to show sufficient proof of continuing medical education since the last application, which may include seminars or podiatry meetings.

available.quote: The board may issue a license without examination to a podiatrist of another state or Canadian province if: 1. The other state or Canadian province grants like privileges to podiatrists of this state;

requirements.value: Reciprocal privileges required from other state/province; equal statutory requirements; active practice for at least 2 years preceding application; current license in good standing; no disciplinary history; fee not to exceed $500; malpractice settlement disclosure.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license without examination to a podiatrist of another state or Canadian province if: 1. title_protection.quote: Use the designation "doctor of podiatric medicine", "podiatrist", "D.P.M.", "podiatric physician", "chiropodist", "foot specialist", or "foot doctor", or use any title, degree, letters, symbol, or words that would tend to lead the public to believe that that person is authorized to practice or assume duties incident to the practice of podiatric medicine.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to demonstrate the qualification or satisfy the requirements for a license or permit under this chapter or rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license or permit by fraud, cheating, or use of false or fraudulent documents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a license or permit by fraud or cheating or attempting to subvert the licensing or permit examination process, the use of any false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction within the previous five years of a misdemeanor or felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction, during the previous five years, of a misdemeanor or felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine, or determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a person's ability to serve the public as a podiatrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against the podiatric license in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, restriction, limitation, or other disciplinary action against the person's podiatric medical license in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false or misleading, or making false statements about skill, training, or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is false or misleading, or the making of any false or misleading statement about the podiatrist's skill, training, experience, or ability or the efficacy of any treatment or remedy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule or order of the board, any provision of this chapter, or applicable state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule adopted by the board; an order of the board; any provision of this chapter; any action, stipulation, condition, or agreement imposed by the board; a state or federal law that relates to the practice of podiatric medicine; or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unethical conduct or professionally incompetent practice that may endanger patient safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any unethical conduct; conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public; demonstrating a willful, careless, or negligent disregard for the health, welfare, or safety of a patient; or podiatric medical practice that is professionally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise a preceptor or resident
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise a preceptor or resident.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person in the practice of podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or dangerous to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication by a court of competent jurisdiction as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, a person dangerous to the public, or a person who has a psychopathic personality.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct departing from minimal standards of acceptable podiatric medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unprofessional conduct that includes any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatric medical practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental illness or substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of physical or mental illness, a substance use disorder, or as a result of any mental or physical condition or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except as required or permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when otherwise required or permitted by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper management of medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper management of medical records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting or paying fees for patient referrals, or obtaining fees by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, paying, or promising to pay a part of a fee in exchange for patient referrals; obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of, or addiction to, alcohol or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of, or becoming addicted or habituated to, alcohol or drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, administering, or distributing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, administering, or distributing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes, experimental, or investigative purposes authorized by a state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual misconduct, sexual abuse, or exploitation with or of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual misconduct, sexual abuse, or exploitation with or of a patient; conduct that may reasonably be interpreted by the patient as sexual; or in verbal behavior which is seductive or sexually demeaning to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or representatives information legally requested by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to furnish the board or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a podiatrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a podiatrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatric medicine under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine under a false or assumed name other than a partnership name containing the names of one or more of the licensed partners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a professional office in conjunction with any business not engaged in medical sciences
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Maintaining a professional office in conjunction or relation with any business not engaged in the practice of the medical sciences.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Treating any disease, sickness, illness, malady, or defect outside the scope of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Treating any disease, sickness, illness, malady, or defect that is outside the scope of the practice of podiatric medicine.

definition_quote.value: The medical and surgical treatment and diagnosis of ailments of the human foot, ankle, and other related soft tissue structures below the tibial tuberosity that govern the functions of the foot and ankle, not including extra articular osseous injuries above the distal metaphyseal scar.
